name: federal-awards-by-company
title: Federal Contracts & Grants by Company (USAspending)
description: Get the federal contracts, grants and loans any US company won, from official USAspending.gov data. Search by company name or UEI, agency, NAICS, PSC, state or keyword. Returns award rows plus a company summary: total obligated, top agencies and NAICS. Misses are free.
